GREG, 2026-11-17 about 01:28-01:30Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1408 and #1410), verbatim: „Czekamy na sync. Mogę przenieść development na macos. Chodzi mi głównio o Comovo.” then „Skończmy sync. Jak zadziała to zaczniemy testy na comovo. To nie zmienia planów.” Meaning per Asistant: priorities and plans stay unchanged. First deliver a working, verified sync; Comovo (repo aolowko/fit_friends, Flutter) then becomes its first real use and test, possibly with development on the Mac. Add no extra conditions or procedures and ask Greg for no decisions now; don't pause the current P0s. Protecting existing uncommitted work, such as the 56 lines in the Central checkout, stays obvious. A preliminary plan was sent to Greg at 43498a6e #1409.
Mac facts (read-only check by the Mac Engram Runner, 01:33Z):
- Checkout /Users/greg/GitHub/Personal/fit_friends, branch main at b39c0e11, the same commit as Central; the rincon-common submodule is initialised at 9935011e but differs from the recorded revision ("+").
- Flutter 3.47.2 stable (cached metadata), Dart 3.13.2 macos_arm64, Xcode 27.1, CocoaPods 1.17.0, OpenJDK 23.0.1, Android SDK at /Users/greg/Library/Android/sdk with platform-tools 37.0.1 (ANDROID_HOME unset, adb not on PATH).
- engram at /Users/greg/.cargo/bin/engram is an OLD build (8bbf9d60, rev 0bd70a30, 2026-11-09). There is no Engram store home on the Mac (ENGRAM_HOME unset, ~/.engram absent).
So on the Mac the toolchain is present; what's needed is a current Engram build plus a store created by importing the sync data.
